definitions.explanation: showing skill and cleverness, often in a cunning way

examples.japanese: {巧妙|こうみょう}な{手口|てぐち}だ。
{詐欺師|さぎし}の{巧妙|こうみょう}な{手法|しゅほう}に{騙|だま}された。
examples.english: I was deceived by the swindler's ingenious methods.

examples.japanese: {巧妙|こうみょう}に{仕組|しく}まれた{罠|わな}だった。
examples.english: It was a cleverly designed trap.

notes:
{巧妙|こうみょう} describes cleverness that is often cunning or strategic, not always positive.

WORD TYPE:
- Na-adjective
- Adverbial form: {巧妙|こうみょう}に

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {巧|こう} (skillful)
- {妙|みょう} (mysterious, strange, clever)

NUANCE:
- Often implies cunning or craftiness
- Frequently used for deceptive or strategic schemes
- Can be neutral (skillful technique) or negative (devious)
- More literary/formal than {上手|じょうず}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巧妙|こうみょう}な{手口|てぐち} (clever trick/method)
- {巧妙|こうみょう}な{手法|しゅほう} (ingenious technique)
- {巧妙|こうみょう}な{罠|わな} (clever trap)
- {巧妙|こうみょう}に{仕組|しく}む (cleverly devise)
- {巧妙|こうみょう}に{隠|かく}す (cleverly hide)

USAGE CONTEXT:
- Crime reports (fraud, scams)
- Political maneuvering
- Strategic planning
- Literary descriptions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上手|じょうず} (skillful - neutral/positive)
- {器用|きよう} (dexterous, handy)
- {狡猾|こうかつ} (cunning - more negative)
- {巧|たく}み (skillful - more positive)

REGISTER: Formal. Common in news reports and formal writing.
